subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should ClawHub offer a paid expedited human-review certificate or badge for skills, and what assurance scope, payment/SLA, expiry, revocation, and relationship to existing Official/Verified/scan signals should it have?
rationale: The request would create a public security assurance signal and a paid marketplace workflow, while current specs explicitly keep paid features out of v1 and current code only has adjacent moderation/trust primitives.

options.title: Define policy pilot first
options.body: Keep this open as a product/security policy item and define criteria, authority, payment/refund/SLA, expiry, revocation, and public wording before implementation.

options.title: Reject paid certificate for now
options.body: Document that ClawHub will not offer paid skill review badges while paid features remain out of scope, leaving users with scan, Official, and moderation signals.

options.title: Implement full paid review program
options.body: Approve the paid review product direction and then scope a broad implementation across schema, payments, queues, staff tools, public UI/API, audit logs, and docs.

recommendation.title: Define policy pilot first
recommendation.body: Keep this open as a product/security policy item and define criteria, authority, payment/refund/SLA, expiry, revocation, and public wording before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current badge, moderation override, official-publisher, and paid-skill policy surfaces are attributed to this history path.
